parameters.name: CommonTransferConfig
parameters.description: Common transfer configuration.

parameters.name: EnableFullTransfer
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable full data transfer.

parameters.name: EnableFullVerify
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable full verification.

parameters.name: EnableIncrTransfer
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable incremental synchronization.

parameters.name: EnableReverseIncrTransfer
parameters.description: Whether reverse incremental synchronization is enabled.

parameters.name: EnableStructTransfer
parameters.description: Specifies whether to allow structure transfer.

parameters.name: FullTransferConfig
parameters.description: Configuration for full data transfer.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration or data synchronization task. You can obtain the ID of the task to be configured by invoking the ListProjects API.

parameters.name: IncrTransferConfig
parameters.description: Configuration for incremental synchronization.

parameters.name: LabelIds
parameters.description: A collection of label IDs. Up to 5 labels are supported.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the data migration or data synchronization task.

parameters.name: OssKey
parameters.description: The OssKey obtained by calling GetUploadOssUrl.

parameters.name: ReverseIncrTransferConfig
parameters.description: Reverse incremental transfer configuration.

parameters.name: SinkEndpointId
parameters.description: The DataSource ID of the target endpoint. You can obtain the ID by invoking the `ListDataSource` API. The format is e_****.

parameters.name: SourceEndpointId
parameters.description: The ID of the source data source. You can obtain the ID by invoking the `ListDataSource` API. The format is e_****.

parameters.name: StructTransferConfig
parameters.description: Configuration for structure transfer.

parameters.name: TransferMapping
parameters.description: Mapping information of transfer objects.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of the job, which can be `MIGRATION` (indicating a data migration task) or `SYNC` (indicating a data synchronization task).

parameters.name: UseOss
parameters.description: Indicates whether to use OSS for Creation.

parameters.name: WorkerGradeId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the transmission instance. You must invoke the ListProjects API to obtain the ID of the task to be configured.
